| 01  BRAND FOUNDATION *Mission · Vision · Values · Positioning* |
| :---: |

# **Brand Foundation**

## **Mission Statement**

*To replace expensive, fragmented SaaS stacks with AI-coded custom apps, deliver White Glove IT care to the clients Big Tech ignores, and run it all from a 100% solar-powered, ADA-accessible, family-owned data center in Park City, Kansas.*

## **Vision**

Kecktech is the IT partner that treats every client like a neighbor — whether that's an overwhelmed small business owner, a senior trying to stay safe online, or a company tired of paying $1,200 a month for tools they barely use. We prove that local, sovereign, sustainable technology is not just possible — it's better.

## **Core Values**

| HumanFirst | Technology serves people, not the other way around. Every design decision, every product, every interaction starts with the human on the other end — especially the ones that technology has historically left behind. |
| :---: | :---- |
| **Sovereign& Private** | **Your data stays in Kansas, on our servers, under your terms.** We don't sell your data, scan your data, or profit from your data. Private hosting and client-owned code are features, not upsells. |
| **Solar \&Circular** | **100% solar-powered. Zero e-waste from our clients.** Every device in our HaaS fleet is refurbished enterprise hardware. Every watt that runs our servers comes from our 25kW rooftop array. Sustainability is a business model, not a marketing claim. |
| **RadicallyAccessible** | **ADA-first in everything: our building, our software, our team.** Both founders live with physical disabilities. Accessibility is not a checkbox. It's in the blueprint, the codebase, the knowledge base, and the client experience. |
| **WhiteGlove** | **Real humans, real accountability, real care.** No offshore call centers. No automated runaround. When you need us, a real person answers. For our senior clients especially, patience and dignity are non-negotiable. |

## **Brand Positioning Statement**

| FOR *Small businesses and seniors in Kansas and beyond who are overwhelmed by technology, overpaying for fragmented tools, or being underserved by impersonal IT providers —* KECKTECH IS THE IT PARTNER *that delivers sovereign, solar-powered, human-centered technology — from a family-owned, disability-led data center in Park City, Kansas — because every business and every person deserves IT that actually works for them.* |
| :---: |

| 02  LOGO *Usage · Versions · Clear Space · Restrictions* |
| :---: |

# **Logo**

The Kecktech logo consists of two elements: the wordmark ("Keck" in navy, "tech" in charcoal) and the connector icon above it — a stylized network/DNA wave with circular nodes representing connected technology and human relationship. Together they communicate precision, connectivity, and approachability.

## **Primary Logo — Full Color**

![][image1]

Use the full-color logo on white or very light neutral backgrounds. This is the preferred version for all primary applications: website header, documents, presentations, email signatures, business cards, and signage.

## **Logo Versions**

| Version | When to Use | Background Requirements |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **Full color** | Primary — always prefer this | White, off-white, or very light backgrounds only (\#F4F7FB or lighter) |
| **Transparent PNG** | Digital use on light or colored backgrounds | Use on any background where the navy wordmark provides adequate contrast |
| **Reversed / White** | Dark backgrounds only | Navy (\#1E3A5F), dark photos, dark UI panels. Use white/light version of wordmark |
| **Monochrome (Navy)** | Single-color print | When color printing is not available. Full logo in \#1E3A5F only |
| **Icon only** | Favicon, app icon, small contexts | Use only at small sizes (32px and below) where wordmark would be illegible |

## **Minimum Size**

| Application | Minimum Width | Notes |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Digital / Screen | 120px | Below this, use icon only |
| Print — business card | 0.75 inches | Test legibility of wordmark |
| Print — documents | 1.0 inch | Standard document header size |
| Signage / large format | No minimum | Scale proportionally; use vector SVG source |

## **Clear Space**

Always maintain a clear space around the logo equal to the height of the letter 'K' in the wordmark. No text, graphics, or other elements should appear within this zone. This protects the logo's visual integrity and readability.

## **Logo Do's and Don'ts**

| DO | DON'T |
| :---- | :---- |
| ✓  Use the full-color version on white/light backgrounds | ✗  Stretch, distort, or skew the logo in any direction |
| ✓  Maintain clear space on all four sides | ✗  Change any color in the logo |
| ✓  Use the transparent PNG for digital overlays | ✗  Add drop shadows, glows, or effects to the logo |
| ✓  Scale proportionally — always maintain aspect ratio | ✗  Place the logo on a busy photo or patterned background |
| ✓  Use SVG for any printed or large-format application | ✗  Recreate or redraw the logo in any application |
| ✓  Use the reversed version on dark backgrounds | ✗  Add an outline or border around the logo |
|  | ✗  Place text or graphics within the clear space zone |
|  | ✗  Use low-resolution (raster) files for print |

## **Accessibility — Contrast Ratios**

All primary text/background combinations used by Kecktech meet WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 minimum). Senior-facing interfaces target WCAG AAA (7:1 minimum).

| Combination | Application | Ratio | WCAG Level | Pass? |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Navy on White | Headings, logo wordmark | 11.2:1 | AAA | **PASS** |
| Charcoal on White | Body text | 9.7:1 | AAA | **PASS** |
| White on Navy | Buttons, headers | 11.2:1 | AAA | **PASS** |
| Gold on Navy | Highlights, CTAs | 4.9:1 | AA | **PASS** |
| Navy on Off-White | Cards, page content | 10.8:1 | AAA | **PASS** |
| White on Steel | Secondary buttons | 4.6:1 | AA | **PASS** |

| 04  TYPOGRAPHY *Typefaces · Hierarchy · Sizing · Accessibility* |
| :---: |

# **Typography**

Kecktech uses two typefaces: Poppins for headings and Calibri / Open Sans for body text. Both are free, widely available, and highly legible across screen and print. The combination balances modern confidence (Poppins) with approachability and readability (Open Sans).

## **Typeface Stack**

| Role | Typeface | Weight(s) | Use |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **Display / Hero** | **Poppins** | 700 Bold | Hero headlines, Kickstarter headlines, large display text |
| **Headings (H1–H3)** | **Poppins** | 600 SemiBold  /  700 Bold | Section titles in documents, web pages, presentations |
| **UI Labels / Nav** | **Poppins** | 500 Medium | Navigation items, button labels, table headers, tags |
| **Body Text** | **Open Sans** | 400 Regular  /  600 SemiBold | All body copy — web, documents, emails, knowledge base |
| **Captions / Meta** | **Open Sans** | 400 Regular  /  Italic | Photo captions, metadata, footnotes, timestamps |
| **Code / Technical** | **Courier New  /  JetBrains Mono** | 400 Regular | Code snippets, hex color values, file paths, config values |
| **Documents (Office)** | **Calibri (fallback)** | 400 / 700 | Word docs, PDFs when Poppins/Open Sans unavailable. Calibri is acceptable as a universal fallback. |

## **Type Scale**

| Level | Size (Web) | Size (Print) | Weight | Notes |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **Display** | 48–64px | 36–48pt | 700 | Hero sections, Kickstarter cover |
| **H1** | 36px | 28pt | 700 | Section headings, page titles |
| **H2** | 28px | 22pt | 600 | Subsection headings |
| **H3** | 22px | 16pt | 600 | Component headings |
| **Body (standard)** | 16px | 12pt | 400 | General web and print body copy |
| **Body (senior-facing)** | 18–24px | 14–16pt | 400 | WikiJS, senior client portal — WCAG AAA required |
| **Caption / Meta** | 13–14px | 10pt | 400 | Never smaller than 13px on web |

## **Senior Accessibility Typography Rules**

| SENIOR-FACING INTERFACES ONLY (WikiJS, senior client portal, help.kecktech.net) Minimum body font size: 18px (24px preferred) Line height: 1.8 minimum All links must be underlined (not color alone) Contrast ratio: 7:1 minimum (WCAG AAA) No italics for body text (reduces legibility at large sizes) No justified text (creates uneven spacing) Button minimum height: 48px / 36pt |

| 05  VOICE & TONE *Brand Voice · Tone by Audience · Messaging Framework* |
| :---: |

# **Voice & Tone**

## **The Kecktech Voice**

Kecktech's brand voice is the same whether we're writing an investor pitch, a senior's knowledge base article, or an SMB's IT service agreement. The voice is consistent — only the tone adjusts based on audience.

| Voice Trait | What It Means | In Practice | Never |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **Knowledgeable** | We have 30+ years of enterprise IT experience. We speak with authority. | Use precise technical terms when helpful; always explain them in plain language. | Condescending. Never make anyone feel dumb. |
| **Warm** | We're a family business. We care about the people we serve, not just the tickets we close. | "We'll take care of that for you."  "Let us know if anything's confusing." | Corporate jargon. Cold, robotic tone. |
| **Honest** | We say what we can do, what we can't, and how much it costs. No fine print surprises. | If something will take time, we say so. If a service isn't right for a client, we tell them. | Overselling. Buried fees. Vague promises. |
| **Plain-spoken** | We replace tech jargon with plain language — without dumbing anything down. | "Your computer" not "endpoint device." "Backup" not "redundant data replication." | Buzzwords, acronyms without explanation, unnecessary complexity. |
| **Purposeful** | Everything we do has a reason: solar power, local hosting, ADA design. We explain the why. | "We run on solar because we believe your data center shouldn't pollute the planet." | Greenwashing. Claiming values we don't live by. |

## **Tone by Audience**

| Audience | Tone | Language Level | Example Phrase |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **Senior clients** | Warm, patient, reassuring, slow-paced | Plain English. No acronyms. Short sentences. | "Your computer is all set. We checked everything and you're protected." |
| **SMB owners** | Professional, direct, efficient, practical | Business English. Minimal jargon. Results-focused. | "We cut your IT spend from $800/mo to $49/mo and you own the code." |
| **Investors / Grants** | Confident, data-driven, visionary | Financial and strategic language. Back everything with numbers. | "$1.098M ARR target at full ramp, 66% blended margin, break-even Month 18." |
| **Kickstarter backers** | Inspiring, personal, community-focused | Conversational. Tell the story. Use "we" and "you." | "We're two people in Kansas with disabilities building the IT company we wish had existed." |
| **Technical staff** | Precise, efficient, peer-to-peer | Technical terms are fine. Be direct. | "Run startup-all.bat from Dashboard root. Check REMAINING-TASKS.md for TOTP enrollment." |

## **Core Messaging Pillars**

Use these proof points when writing marketing copy, investor materials, or social media posts. Every piece of Kecktech communication should tie back to at least one of these.

| Pillar | Supporting Messages |
| ----- | ----- |
| **Solar-Powered** | 100% solar-powered data center  ·  25kW array \+ 100kWh battery  ·  Your data runs on sunshine  ·  Zero grid dependency planned  ·  Lower carbon footprint than any hyperscale provider |
| **Sovereign Data** | Your data never leaves Kansas  ·  We own the servers  ·  No third-party scanning or monetization  ·  HIPAA-ready private hosting  ·  Client owns the code we build |
| **AI-Built Apps** | Replace $800/mo SaaS stacks with custom apps you own  ·  Built in weeks, not months  ·  ROI payback under 18 months  ·  Hosted on Kecktech's solar servers  ·  No recurring license fees |
| **Human-Centered** | ADA-accessible facility and software  ·  Disability-led founders  ·  Seniors get the same quality service as enterprises  ·  Real humans answer the phone  ·  Designed for the people Big Tech ignores |
| **Local & Independent** | Family-owned  ·  Park City, Kansas  ·  Kansas jobs, Kansas taxes, Kansas values  ·  Circular economy hardware  ·  Community-first pricing |

| **02** | **Hardware-as-a-Service (HaaS)** | $149/mo/device | \#2E7D32  Forest Green | Refurbished enterprise hardware on subscription. Circular economy — zero e-waste from clients. |
| **03** | **AI Custom App Development** | $3K–$8K/build | \#C07810  Solar Gold | AI-powered custom apps that replace $800+/mo SaaS stacks. Client owns the code. |

## **Service Naming Rules**

| DO | DON'T |
| :---- | :---- |
| ✓  Use the full service name on first mention: "White Glove Managed IT" | ✗  Abbreviate to "MSP" without first saying "White Glove Managed IT (MSP)" |
| ✓  Use "HaaS" as an abbreviation after first use of the full name | ✗  Call Service 3 "app development" — always say "AI Custom App Development" |
| ✓  Capitalize all five words in "White Glove Managed IT" | ✗  Use "senior care" or "elder care" — this is tech, not healthcare |
| ✓  Refer to Service 4 as "Senior Technology Concierge" — not "senior support" | ✗  Mix up service colors between services |
| ✓  Use the service color consistently in UI and marketing for that service | ✗  Add or remove services without updating this guide |

| 09  FACILITY IDENTITY *Building · Signage · ADA · Equipment* |

# **Facility & Environmental Identity**

The Kecktech facility in Park City, Kansas is a brand asset in its own right. The 1,500 sq ft purpose-built solar-powered data center communicates credibility, stability, and sustainability in a way no digital asset can. All physical touchpoints should reflect the brand.

## **Building Signage**

| Sign Type | Specification |
| ----- | ----- |
| **Exterior — Main sign** | "SOLAR-LINK IT SOLUTIONS" (or "KECKTECH") in white on Navy (\#1E3A5F) background. Poppins Bold. Illuminated preferred. Above entrance canopy. |
| **Entrance door** | Kecktech logo vinyl decal on glass. Hours of operation below in Open Sans 14pt. |
| **ADA signage** | All ADA required signage in high-contrast black/white. Braille as required. Mount at ADA-specified heights. |
| **Server room door** | "SERVER ROOM — AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY" in Teal (\#0D6E6E) on white. Keycard reader mounted at ADA height. |
| **Battery room door** | "BATTERY & ELECTRICAL — RESTRICTED" with electrical hazard symbol. Yellow/black caution standard. |

## **Equipment Labeling**

All hardware deployed at client sites should be labeled to reinforce the Kecktech brand and make it easy for clients to identify their equipment.

* HaaS devices: Navy label with Kecktech logo, client name, device ID, and support number (kecktech.net or phone)

* Server racks: Teal label with rack number and "Kecktech Data Center — Park City, KS" at top of each rack

* Solar panels: Kecktech branded data tag on inverter with installation date and generation capacity

* Cable management: Color-coded per service — blue for data, orange for power, teal for management

## **"Emergency Tech Card" — Senior Client Deliverable**

Every senior client receives a physical card at onboarding. This is a key brand touchpoint — it should be the most human, approachable piece of Kecktech material we produce.

| Element | Specification |
| ----- | ----- |
| **Size** | 4" × 2.5" (slightly larger than business card for legibility) |
| **Font size** | Minimum 14pt. "CALL US" in 24pt+ Poppins Bold. |
| **Content** | Front: KECKTECH logo · "NEED HELP?" · Phone number in very large text · "We're here for you."  Back: RustDesk ID (pre-filled), hours, kecktech.net |
| **Colors** | White background · Navy text · Solar Gold for phone number (high contrast, attention-grabbing) |
| **Finish** | Laminated. Cannot be damaged by water or handling. Designed to be kept on the refrigerator. |
